# Kozker Tech

> Intelligent systems, custom business intelligence, AI triage copilots, and multi-system workflow automation that scale modern operations.

Kozker Tech designs and engineers production BI dashboards, multilingual AI voice & chat assistants, and multi-system automations that eliminate manual busywork and streamline operations.

## Core Services & Capabilities

- [Data & BI Services](https://kozker.com/services?tab=data-bi): Scalable real-time executive dashboards, multi-source ETL pipelines, and SQL/Power BI architecture.
- [AI Assistants & Copilots](https://kozker.com/services?tab=ai-assistants): 24/7 multilingual conversational triage systems, RAG knowledge copilots, and EHR integration.
- [Workflow Automation](https://kozker.com/services?tab=automation): Cross-platform API pipelines, inventory sync, multi-carrier logistics, and SLA automation.

## Products & Platforms

- [Kozker Recruiter AI](https://recruiter-landing-page-olive.vercel.app/): End-to-end recruitment operations platform, candidate screening, automated portal triage, and SLA tracking.
- [Automated Financial BI Suite](https://kozker.com/products): Financial modeling, automated month-end reconciliation, and real-time executive dashboards.

## Case Studies & Verified Outcomes

- [Building an AI-Powered WhatsApp Voice & Health Helpline for Brooke India](https://kozker.com/case-studies/brooke-india-whatsapp-equine-helpline): 24/7 WhatsApp helpline transcribing regional voice notes and connecting owners to local equine veterinarians.
- [Replacing Spreadsheets with a Custom Recruitment Platform & AI Matcher](https://kozker.com/case-studies/custom-recruitment-platform-ai-matching): Unified recruitment workspace eliminating duplicate candidate entries with evidence-based resume quote scoring.
- [Adding an In-App AI Chat Copilot to a Frappe ERP Recruitment System](https://kozker.com/case-studies/frappe-erp-ai-recruiter-copilot): In-app ERP sidebar for IT staffing agencies automating JD conversion and screening evaluations via plain English.
- [Centralizing Recruitment Data & Building Automated Power BI Dashboards](https://kozker.com/case-studies/recruitment-power-bi-dashboards): Centralized MariaDB staging pipeline and automated Power BI reporting eliminating manual weekly Excel MIS.
- [Streamlining Client Intake, Document Collection & Approval Workflows for a CA Firm](https://kozker.com/case-studies/chartered-accountancy-workflow-automation): 8-stage automated workflow managing client intake, missing document alerts, partner reviews, and payment-gated delivery.
- [Designing an AI Telecalling & Appointment Rescheduling System for Hospitals](https://kozker.com/case-studies/hospital-ai-telecalling-appointment-system): Integrated voice AI and WhatsApp system managing doctor consultation slots and automated emergency rescheduling.
